options.content: Raw orderbook/trade feed health before interval aggregation, plus local/global price-volume comparison.

targets.rawSql:
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange || ' ' || scope.symbol AS metric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  (e.exchange || ' ' || e.symbol) AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'MarketEvent'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH role_exchange AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT role, exchange, symbol
  FROM (
    SELECT 'local'::text AS role, e.exchange AS exchange, e.symbol AS symbol
    FROM mm_events e
    WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
      AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
      AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
      AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
      AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT gates.value->>'role' AS role, gates.key AS exchange, e.symbol AS symbol
    FROM mm_events e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
      COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
    ) AS gates(key, value)
    WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
      AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
      AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
      AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
      AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
      AND gates.value->>'role' IN ('local', 'global')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'local'::text,
           jf.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'],
           jf.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','symbol']
    FROM mm_events jf
    WHERE jf.event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
      AND (jf.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','symbol']) = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
      AND $__timeFilter(jf.ts)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'global'::text,
           jf.payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'],
           jf.payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','symbol']
    FROM mm_events jf
    WHERE jf.event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
      AND (jf.payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange']) IS NOT NULL
      AND (jf.payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','symbol']) = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
      AND $__timeFilter(jf.ts)
  ) r
  WHERE role IN ('local', 'global')
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
    AND symbol IS NOT NULL AND symbol <> ''
)
SELECT m.ts AS "time", (m.exchange || ' best_bid') AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload #>> ARRAY['orderbook','bids','0','price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload #>> ARRAY['orderbook','bids','0','price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events m
JOIN role_exchange r ON r.role = 'local' AND r.exchange = m.exchange AND r.symbol = m.symbol
WHERE m.event_type = 'MarketEvent'
  AND m.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND m.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (m.payload->'orderbook'->'bids'->0->>'price') IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(m.ts)
UNION ALL

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','symbol'] AS symbol, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','symbol'] AS symbol, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT symbol, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE symbol IS NOT NULL AND symbol <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE symbol IS NOT NULL AND symbol <> ''
  GROUP BY symbol
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
